notes.title: "One More Hound!" RELEASED!!!
notes.notes:
[b]One More Hound! [/b]It's my first solo game and I'm proud and happy to release today!
It's been a dream to create a game and with this one a learned so much about developing. I almost gave up because doing everything on my own was hard ...but it's finally here!
I hope that everyone enjoy it , recommend it to their friends and of course buy it, to help me add more features to the game!!

You can share your top rankings with the twitter [b]@onemorehound[/b] , I'll be happy to comment and share it !

At, Paulo Vieira.
 🐶😁❤️
